description.short: A senior Excel expert for any workbook
description.full: A senior Excel expert for any workbook. Tell me in plain words what to add, change, fix or tidy - rows, columns, formulas, lookups, dropdowns, highlights, sorting, duplicates, summaries, charts - and I'll make exactly that change, keep every formula, total and table working, and show you precisely which cells changed. Personal data is protected automatically.
